body:
Part of #36. Plan step **P05**. Functional composition first, focused visual refinement second. Real-data readiness also depends on P03 (#40); mocks are never labelled as market results.

Blocked by: #38, #41. These are completion dependencies; synthetic groundwork exceptions are stated below.

## Outcome

The owner opens one monthly profit page, scans overall results, scrolls to product contributions and opens evidence without switching between competing financial/source interfaces. One page remains composed of focused existing modules, not a giant component or concatenated full pages.

## Composition and reuse

- [ ] Use the agreed P01 (#38) sketch and P04 (#41) report contract. Reuse `AppShell`, `MonthlyWorkspace`/`MonthlyOverview`, sales table/chart patterns, cost evidence and report-version/export controls. Extract only sections actually required for composition; keep unrelated pages intact until their entry points are accounted for.
- [ ] Arrange: one month selector and compact cutoff/status → overall estimated gross profit and cost coverage → daily profit trend → product contribution table → selected product/transaction/cost evidence. Provide simple in-page jump links if the page length warrants them.
- [ ] Keep raw records, source configuration, import/recovery, existing expense entry and saved reports reachable through appropriate secondary actions. Reuse #37 SQL startup. Do not delete data or route unvalidated preview rows through financial components.
- [ ] Product rows show approved product labels, quantity with unit, net sales, historical estimated cost, profit and coverage. Search/sort must preserve declared scope. Detail explains the product's actual component lines rather than assuming one purchase price for the entire month.
- [ ] Use one report context and consistent month/product state. Reject late responses from the previous selection; preserve scroll/focus on drill-down and return. Expanding lower sections must not silently change the headline's scope.
- [ ] Keep large tables/evidence bounded and paginate or load on demand using the existing patterns. A scrolling page must not eagerly render/load the full historical dataset.
- [ ] Implement truthful empty, unsupported, partial-cost, stale-source, failure/retry and offline states. Critical uncertainty stays beside affected values; raw schema IDs, hashes and long method explanations go in expandable detail. No fabricated profit placeholders outside explicitly synthetic design fixtures.
- [ ] After the functional flow passes, refine Turkish labels, hierarchy, spacing, numeric alignment, restrained charts and repeated text. Preserve keyboard access, visible focus, one main landmark, table alternatives, chart units/zero baselines and 200% zoom usability.

## Touch points and verification

[src/ui/App.tsx](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/src/ui/App.tsx), `AppShell.tsx`, `overview/MonthlyWorkspace.tsx`, `overview/MonthlyOverview.tsx`, `SalesWorkspace.tsx`, `purchasing/PurchasingWorkspace.tsx`, `overview/ReportEvidence.tsx`, `reports/ReportVersions.tsx`, `style.css` as required. New sections only where an existing section cannot be composed cleanly; no design-system replacement or dependencies by default.

Extend packaged checks in `tests/desktop/monthly-overview.test.ts`, `sales-drilldown.test.ts`, `unavailable-states.test.ts`, `source-workspace.test.ts` and report pagination/version tests. First expose the missing owner journey; then make the smallest composition changes. Use synthetic screenshots for layout review. Verify actual actions and displayed values, not screenshots alone.

## Exit gate

A packaged-app walkthrough answers all three owner questions from one page, shows unavailable/partial profit honestly, and reaches original line evidence. Existing import, expenses, saved reports and recovery remain accessible. User review of the working layout precedes final cosmetic refinement; Windows/full-volume acceptance is P06.

## Execution and evidence

This is a planning backlog, not an instruction to start implementation. First settle the named decisions in P01 (#38) with the user. For each behavioral change, expose the missing contract with a focused failing test, record the actual failure, make the smallest implementation change, and run the relevant checks. Reuse the existing Vitest, Playwright packaged-desktop and synthetic SQL harness; do not create a new orchestration framework.

Use coherent Conventional Commits (`test:`, `feat:`/`fix:`, then evidence as needed). Record the task/gate, commit/build, opaque fixture/source batch, environment, command/procedure, expected and actual result, evidence location and remaining limits. Synthetic success is not source validation; macOS success is not Windows acceptance. Preserve unrelated work and accepted reports. Source access and production rollout retain their separate authorization boundaries.
title: [P1] Compose one scrolling profit workspace from existing UI components
